privateNetworkCluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see Private Network Clusters Note: Private Network add-on is only supported on AWS_VPC/GCP/ONPREMISES for Kafka Connect. The target Kafka cluster has to be on AWS_VPC/GCP/ONPREMISES respectively as well.

pciCompliantCluster.description: Creates a PCI compliant cluster, see PCI Compliance. Can only be applied clusters provisioned on AWS_VPC or GCP, running Cadence, Cassandra, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis and Valkey. PCI compliance cannot be enabled if the cluster has Spark.

indexManagementPlugin.description: Enables Index Management Plugin. This helps automate recurring index management activities.

anomalyDetectionPlugin.description: Enables the Anomaly Detection Plugin. This allows for the detection of unusual or anomalous data points in your time-series data. Supported on OpenSearch 2.x for versions >= 2.4.0 and 1.x for versions >= 1.3.7

sqlPlugin.description: Enables the SQL Plugin. This allows you to query you indices with SQL as an alternative to the OpenSearch Query DSL. Supported on OpenSearch 2.x for versions >= 2.4.0 and 1.x for versions >= 1.3.7

asynchronousSearchPlugin.description: Enables the Anomaly Detection Plugin. This allows you to submit queries to be completed asynchronously. Supported on OpenSearch 2.x for versions >= 2.4.0 and 1.x for versions 1.3.7

synchronousModeStrict.description: Accepts true/false. Enables synchronous mode strict for clusters with SYNCHRONOUS replication mode.

PrivateLink.description: Creates a PrivateLink cluster, see PrivateLink PrivateLink can only be supported on AWS_VPC for Kafka.

accountName.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the console, or the “Provider Account” property on any existing cluster. For customers running in Instaclustr account, this property may be omitted.

customVirtualNetworkId.description:
AWS: VPC ID to provision data centre into, cluster network must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.
GCP: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI e.g. projects/my-project/regions/us-central1/subnetworks/my-subnet, cluster network must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet.

tags.description: AWS_VPC, GCP, AZURE and AZURE_AZ only. If specified, the value is a map from tag key to value. For AWS_VPC restrictions, refer to the AWS User Guide. Tags are defined per cluster and will be applied to every instance in the cluster.

resourceGroup.description: AZURE only. If specified, the value is the name for an Azure Resource Group which the resources will be provisioned into.

diskEncryptionKey.description: AWS_VPC only. Specify a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Account settings before provisioning an encrypted cluster.

numberOfRacks.description: Number of racks to use when allocating nodes
